notes: Repairs bounded provider retry/backoff for rate limits and transient upstream failures.
Makes persisted Research recoverable when Angle generation fails, without duplicating Research.
Restores FR-02 multi-Brand creation inside an existing authenticated Workspace.
Strengthens tenant-isolation regressions and authenticated multi-Brand smoke coverage.
Adds exact web/API release-SHA provenance; empty Vercel Git metadata no longer masks the build-generated exact SHA fallback.

Production smoke exposed a Hermes Researcher output-contract gap: factual Claims with empty evidenceIds reached domain validation. Reopen VS-73 testing to fail closed at the runtime boundary and provide explicit Researcher/Strategist Hermes contracts.
Concurrent production smoke requests exposed duplicate Research persistence for the same Idea; make Research and candidate-Angle persistence idempotent after the existing per-Idea database lock.
Final production smoke exposed malformed direct-model Drafter JSON under generic json_object mode; bind content-draft and critic-review to strict provider-side JSON schemas before runtime validation.

Production deployment exposed that the existing Instagram publishing worker was built but never started by the API container; launch that existing worker only when explicitly production-enabled so approved publish commands can reach Meta without changing approval authority.

Production OAuth diagnostics proved Meta redirects to the Vercel web callback path, but that route was missing; add a server-side authenticated callback handoff that consumes code/state and persists the eligible Instagram Channel Account, with explicit selection only when Meta returns multiple accounts.

approvals.rationale: Owner explicitly prioritized fixing real publishing before concurrent Research and authorized use of the existing Instagram page for live validation; callback repair is required to make that connection real.
The callback invokes the already-approved OAuth service and existing candidate selection rules; no new permissions, autonomous approval authority, token exposure, or publishing bypass is introduced.
Owner instructed execution to fix Publish first and granted live Instagram validation authority.
Fresh exact-SHA verification is required after the OAuth callback repair.
Exact merge SHA will be bound after CI and merge.
Instagram publisher is already enabled on the current API; the web callback repair must deploy before the live OAuth/publish validation can proceed.

evidence: Prior certification is historical only. Production verification subsequently exposed publisher startup and OAuth callback defects; both require fresh exact-SHA verification.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Authenticated users can create multiple isolated Brands and reliably progress Brand → Idea → Research → Angles → Campaign → Content → Review → Approval → provider-confirmed Instagram publish under transient provider failures, with exact deployed-SHA provenance.
